item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In April 2023, the Supreme Court ruled unconstitutional the transfer of the National Guard’s organic, administrative, budgetary, and managerial control from the civilian Security Ministry to the Defense Ministry, holding that the force is constitutionally civilian; López Obrador supported military control, argued it was necessary to prevent corruption and ensure professionalism, and criticized the justices as politically biased.","notes":["The excerpt identifies the challenged bill as approved the previous September, but does not itself state the year 2022."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
